description: Per-mandate-type advisor prompt templates for the Policy Mandate Advisor Prompt Composer. One entry per mandate_type. Domain-level defaults handle unmapped types. template_body uses {{ARTIFACT_SUMMARY}}, {{TOOL_NAME}}, {{PERSONA}}, {{EXECUTION_HASH}}, {{CHAIN_DEPTH}}, {{GENERATED_AT}} placeholders.
stochastic_framing_global: Report projections as 'under these assumptions, the result is X' — never 'you will earn X' or 'this will cost Y'.
Flag any input that required a user estimate as an assumption, not a fact.
Do not recommend specific securities, funds, or named financial products.
When regulatory rules are cited, note that they apply as of the artifact's data_vintage and may have changed.

task_frames.plain_summary: Summarize the following decision-tool results in plain language for {{PERSONA}}.
task_frames.next_steps: Based on the following tool results, outline concrete next steps {{PERSONA}} should take, in priority order.
task_frames.compare_options: Compare the options surfaced in the following results and explain the key trade-offs for {{PERSONA}}.
task_frames.advisor_questions: You are preparing a meeting with {{PERSONA}}. Based on the following tool output, generate 5–8 probing advisor questions to deepen understanding before making recommendations.
task_frames.explainer: Explain the methodology, assumptions, and limitations of the following decision-tool output so {{PERSONA}} can evaluate how much weight to give it.

regulatory_citations: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS) — bls.gov/oes
NCES Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) — nces.ed.gov/ipeds
stochastic_framing_rules: Project salary premiums as 'median outcomes observed in BLS OEWS data' — individual results vary by employer, geography, and experience.
Break-even and NPV figures are deterministic given stated inputs; flag sensitivity to discount rate.
escalation_conditions: If NPV is negative at a 5% discount rate, flag as financially marginal and recommend independent verification.
If program cost exceeds 2× the salary premium in year one, flag affordability risk.

regulatory_citations: P.L. 119-21 (OBBBA 2025) — Grad PLUS eliminated for new borrowers after July 1, 2026; RAP replaces income-driven plans
34 CFR Part 685 — PSLF qualifying requirements
ED DCL GEN-26-01 — Pell Grant $7,395 maximum AY2026-27
studentaid.gov/manage-loans
stochastic_framing_rules: All repayment projections assume unchanged income and tax filing status; actual forgiveness timelines depend on IDR recertification and policy continuity.
PSLF forgiveness is tax-free federally (IRC §108(f)(1)); state tax treatment varies.
escalation_conditions: If projected loan balance exceeds 2× starting salary, escalate to a student loan specialist or nonprofit credit counselor.
If borrower is within 24 months of PSLF forgiveness, recommend verification through MOHELA before any refinancing.

regulatory_citations: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS) — bls.gov/oes
IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-32 — 2026 tax parameters
OPM General Schedule Pay Tables — opm.gov/pay-leave
stochastic_framing_rules: Compensation benchmarks reflect published survey medians; individual offers depend on company stage, geography, and negotiating leverage.
Total compensation projections assume equity vests on schedule; actual value depends on exit event and valuation.
escalation_conditions: If equity constitutes more than 30% of total comp, recommend independent equity valuation review.
If relocation is involved, recommend verifying state tax treatment of signing bonus and equity.

regulatory_citations: IRC §83 — property transferred in connection with services
IRC §421, §422 — statutory stock options (ISOs)
IRC §1202 — QSBS exclusion; OBBBA raised per-issuer cap to $15M for stock acquired after July 4, 2025 (P.L. 119-21)
IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-32 — AMT exemption/phaseout
IRC §56, §57 — AMT preferences
stochastic_framing_rules: Tax estimates are illustrative under stated assumptions; actual tax liability requires a licensed CPA or tax attorney.
AMT exposure depends on total AMTI including other ISO exercises and other preference items.
QSBS exclusion percentages are tiered by holding period (3yr=50%, 4yr=75%, 5yr=100% for post-7/4/2025 OBBBA stock).
escalation_conditions: If estimated ISO AMT exposure exceeds $25,000, recommend immediate CPA consultation before exercise.
If company is pre-exit and equity exceeds 5× annual salary in potential value, recommend legal review of §83(b) election deadlines and state tax treatment.

regulatory_citations: IRC §1401 — self-employment tax
IRC §164(f) — deduction for one-half SE tax
IRC §199A — QBI deduction; IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-32 (thresholds: $201,775 single / $403,500 MFJ)
IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-32 — 2026 brackets/standard deduction
stochastic_framing_rules: SE tax estimates assume no W-2 wages offsetting Social Security wage base; adjust if the taxpayer also has employment income.
QBI deduction availability depends on SSTB status, W-2 wages, and qualified property — figures are estimates, not determinations.
escalation_conditions: If net SE income exceeds $200,000, recommend CPA review of S-corp election break-even (IRC §1361/§1362).
If QBI deduction is materially valuable (>$10,000), recommend annual review as thresholds index to inflation.

regulatory_citations: IRC §401(k), §403(b), §457(b) — deferral limits
IRC §408 — IRA limits
IRS Notice 2025-67 — 2026 contribution limits: 401k/403b/457b $24,500; catch-up 50+ $8,000; super catch-up 60-63 $11,250; IRA $7,500
IRC §72(t) — early distribution penalty
stochastic_framing_rules: Retirement projections use stated rate-of-return assumptions; actual portfolio growth is uncertain. Report as 'at X% hypothetical annual return' not 'you will have $Y at retirement'.
Roth vs. traditional analysis depends on expected future tax rate, which is unknown.
escalation_conditions: If employer plan is a 457(b) governmental vs. non-governmental plan, note the significant difference in creditor protection and distribution rules.
If early distribution is being considered, escalate for 72(t) SEPP analysis or hardship documentation.

regulatory_citations: Immigration and Nationality Act (INA) — 8 USC §1101 et seq.
8 CFR §214.2 — nonimmigrant status requirements
USCIS filing fees — uscis.gov/forms (approximate; subject to change)
DOS Visa Bulletin — travel.state.gov (priority date tracking)
stochastic_framing_rules: Immigration processing times are estimates based on USCIS published data; actual timelines vary by service center, category, and premium processing.
Priority date advancement is not guaranteed; retrogression can occur.
escalation_conditions: Any immigration strategy with material financial consequences should be reviewed by a licensed immigration attorney before action.
If employer sponsorship is involved, recommend confirming AC21 portability rights before any job change.

regulatory_citations: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS) — bls.gov/oes
BLS Occupational Outlook Handbook — bls.gov/ooh
stochastic_framing_rules: Automation exposure scores are based on task-composition studies (Frey-Osborne 2013, WEF 2025) and represent population-level risk, not individual job guarantees.
Career transition timelines reflect median search durations; individual results depend on network, geography, and market conditions.
escalation_conditions: If automation exposure score exceeds 70%, recommend skills assessment and credentialing review before any layoff or involuntary separation.
If career break exceeds 18 months, recommend a reentry income gap analysis before committing to an exit date.

regulatory_citations: ACA §36B (26 USC §36B) — Premium Tax Credit; enhanced PTC expired 12/31/2025; 400% FPL cliff reinstated for 2026
IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-19 — 2026 HSA limits: self-only $4,400, family $8,750
CMS — Marketplace plan benchmarks
COBRA — 29 USC §1161
stochastic_framing_rules: HDHP/PPO break-even depends on actual utilization; project at stated utilization scenarios, not as a prediction.
ACA premium estimates are based on benchmark Silver plan premiums; actual premiums depend on plan selection and insurer.
escalation_conditions: If the individual is leaving employer coverage within 60 days, flag the SEP deadline for Marketplace enrollment.
If COBRA is being considered for more than 3 months, compare against Marketplace options before electing.

regulatory_citations: 38 USC Chapter 30 — Montgomery GI Bill (MGIB): $2,518/month FY2026 full-time
38 USC Chapter 33 — Post-9/11 GI Bill: tuition cap $29,920.95 AY2025-26 (private schools)
10 USC §1143a — SkillBridge program authorization
VA.gov — benefit eligibility and BAH rates
stochastic_framing_rules: GI Bill benefits depend on enrollment status, school type, and entitlement months remaining; figures are for full-time 100% entitlement.
BAH rates depend on duty station ZIP code of the school, not residence.
escalation_conditions: If remaining GI Bill entitlement is less than 12 months, recommend accelerated program planning before benefit expiration.
Any VA benefit strategy should be verified through a VSO or directly with VA before enrollment.

regulatory_citations: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS) — bls.gov/oes (construction/trade occupations)
DOL Registered Apprenticeship — apprenticeship.gov
NCCER — nccer.org (credential standards)
stochastic_framing_rules: Wage progression estimates are based on BLS median data by experience tier; union vs. non-union wages differ materially.
Journeyworker wage differentials depend on local JATC agreements.
escalation_conditions: If considering employer-sponsored apprenticeship, verify RAPIDS registration and DOL standards compliance before enrollment.
If overtime reliance is assumed in wage projections, note that overtime is employer-discretionary.

regulatory_citations: IRC §21 — Dependent Care Credit (CDCTC)
IRC §129 — Dependent Care FSA; $7,500 maximum per household (2026, OBBBA-permanent)
IRS Publication 503 — Child and Dependent Care Expenses
stochastic_framing_rules: CDCTC and DC-FSA benefit calculations assume federal tax; state tax treatment varies and may provide additional benefit.
DC-FSA use-it-or-lose-it rule applies unless employer plan permits a rollover/grace period.
escalation_conditions: If household income is below $43,000, the CDCTC percentage peaks at 35% — DC-FSA may still be preferred if state tax rate is material.
Two-earner households: both spouses must have earned income (or be full-time students) to claim either benefit.

regulatory_citations: NCSBN — ncsbn.org (nursing license compacts)
NCEES — ncees.org (engineering license reciprocity)
State professional licensing boards (varies by profession and state)
stochastic_framing_rules: License reciprocity timelines are based on published board data; actual processing times and required documentation vary by state.
CPD/CE credit calculations are based on reported completion pace; verify acceptance with the issuing board before relying on forecasts.
escalation_conditions: Any multistate license strategy should be verified with each target state's licensing board before making career moves.
If a criminal history or disciplinary record exists, recommend direct pre-application inquiry with the licensing board.

regulatory_citations: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS) — bls.gov/oes
WIOA (29 USC §3101 et seq.) — workforce program requirements
apprenticeship.gov — DOL registered programs
stochastic_framing_rules: Workforce program ROI estimates use BLS median wage benchmarks; individual outcomes depend on program quality, local labor demand, and participant effort.
Completion and employment rates vary by provider; verify with state or local workforce board before enrollment.
escalation_conditions: If program cost is funded by a WIOA Individual Training Account (ITA), verify the program appears on the state's Eligible Training Provider List (ETPL).
If participant is currently receiving unemployment benefits, confirm program eligibility rules with the state UI agency.

regulatory_citations: 20 USC §1087 — FAFSA/SAI calculation methodology
IRC §529 — qualified education savings plans
ED DCL GEN-26-01 — Pell Grant maximum $7,395 AY2026-27
studentaid.gov
stochastic_framing_rules: SAI estimates are illustrative; actual EFC/SAI depends on IRS data matching and verification. Families with unusual income situations (business ownership, rental income) should contact the financial aid office directly.
529 projections assume stated contribution rate and investment return; actual account value at enrollment depends on market performance.
escalation_conditions: If FAFSA dependency status is ambiguous (independent student criteria), recommend contacting the financial aid office for a dependency override evaluation.
If family has significant non-retirement assets, recommend a CSS Profile college evaluation alongside FAFSA schools.

regulatory_citations: State noncompete enforceability law (varies by state — CA, ND, OK, MN ban most noncompetes; MA, IL, WA restrict by salary/type)
FTC Rule on Noncompetes — status subject to ongoing litigation as of 2026
stochastic_framing_rules: Noncompete enforceability assessments are based on published state law trends; individual enforceability depends on scope, consideration, and jurisdiction — not a legal opinion.
Report risk scores as 'indicative based on published law' — actual enforceability requires attorney review.
escalation_conditions: If a noncompete covers a broad geographic area or long duration in an enforcement-friendly state, strongly recommend attorney review before accepting new employment.
If the employee is subject to trade secret claims alongside the noncompete, recommend separate IP counsel.

regulatory_citations: FMLA — 29 USC §2601 (12 weeks unpaid leave; employer ≥50 employees)
State paid family leave laws (CA, NY, NJ, WA, CO, MA, OR, DC — vary by benefit percentage and duration)
IRC §21, §129 — dependent care tax benefits
stochastic_framing_rules: Income gap projections depend on employer policy, state PFL benefit, and savings rate — report as scenario analysis, not guarantees.
State PFL benefit calculations assume current benefit rates; rates adjust annually.
escalation_conditions: If employer does not offer PFL and state PFL is unavailable, flag the full income gap risk upfront.
If caregiver is considering a career break exceeding 6 months, recommend a return-to-work scenario analysis before the leave begins.

regulatory_citations: Source citations appear in the tool's data_vintage and regulatory_citations fields
stochastic_framing_rules: Report all projections as scenario-dependent estimates, not guarantees.
Flag any input requiring user estimation as an assumption.
escalation_conditions: If this decision involves a material financial commitment (>$10,000 or >3 months of income), recommend independent professional review before acting.

stochastic_framing_rules: Salary premium is based on BLS OEWS median for the target SOC code — individual offers depend on employer, experience, and geography.
Payback period assumes immediate post-credential employment at the projected salary; actual time-to-employment varies.
escalation_conditions: If NPV is negative at a 5% discount rate and time horizon is less than 7 years, flag as financially marginal.
If program is an ISA, recommend CFPB disclosure review before signing.

stochastic_framing_rules: Human capital scores aggregate BLS and LinkedIn data at the population level; individual career trajectories vary significantly.
Skill velocity metrics reflect platform-reported growth trends, not employer-verified demand in a specific market.
escalation_conditions: If human capital score is declining and automation exposure is high, recommend immediate skills gap analysis.
If the user is over 50 with a declining score, recommend age discrimination awareness alongside upskilling.

stochastic_framing_rules: RAP payments are based on AGI, which changes annually; project payments as 'under current income' not 'fixed for 30 years'.
PSLF qualifying employer status can change; recommend verifying through PSLF Help Tool at studentaid.gov annually.
Forgiveness at end of RAP/IDR period is currently tax-free federally (ARPA through 2025; monitor for extensions beyond 2025 for non-PSLF forgiveness).
escalation_conditions: If total debt exceeds 1.5× starting salary, escalate to a nonprofit student loan counselor (NFCC member).
If borrower has Parent PLUS loans, note they are ineligible for RAP directly — ICR through consolidation is the income-driven option.
If PSLF forgiveness is within 24 months, recommend immediate MOHELA account verification before any refinancing.

stochastic_framing_rules: Salary benchmarks are BLS OEWS medians; actual offer ranges depend on company size, funding stage, and negotiating leverage.
Total comp projections including equity depend on vesting schedule and exit assumptions — report equity value as 'at stated valuation' not as cash.
escalation_conditions: If equity portion exceeds 20% of total comp, recommend ISO vs. NSO classification review.
If offer is from a late-stage private company, recommend asking for a 409A valuation before assessing equity value.

stochastic_framing_rules: ISO AMT estimates are illustrative; actual AMT depends on total AMTI including other preference items and exemption phaseout.
RSU withholding gap projections assume standard supplemental wage withholding (22% federal ≤$1M); actual gap depends on other income.
escalation_conditions: If ISO exercise triggers estimated AMT >$25,000, recommend immediate CPA consultation.
If total equity value exceeds $250,000, recommend annual tax planning session before any exercise or sale.

stochastic_framing_rules: QSBS exclusion eligibility depends on multiple conditions that must be verified (C-corp, active business, $75M gross assets at issuance, 5-year holding for pre-OBBBA stock) — this tool models scenarios, not determinations.
OBBBA tiered exclusion (3yr=50%, 4yr=75%, 5yr=100%) applies only to stock acquired after July 4, 2025; pre-OBBBA stock uses the $10M / 5-year / 100% rule.
escalation_conditions: Any QSBS strategy should be reviewed by a tax attorney before stock acquisition, as the conditions for §1202 qualification must be met at issuance, not at sale.
California does not conform to §1202 — CA residents pay full state tax on gains regardless of federal exclusion.

stochastic_framing_rules: SE tax estimates assume no W-2 income; if the individual also has employment income, the SS wage base ($184,500 in 2026) reduces SE tax owed.
QBI deduction availability for SSTBs phases out above $201,775 (single) / $403,500 (MFJ) — results above these thresholds are partial estimates.
escalation_conditions: If net SE income exceeds $150,000, recommend S-corp election analysis.
If health insurance is a significant cost, verify the IRC §162(l) deduction is captured.

stochastic_framing_rules: Severance negotiation outcomes are probabilistic; anchor, floor, and target figures are framing tools, not guaranteed results.
COBRA cost estimates use current premium; actual COBRA premium is 102% of group premium and may differ by plan election.
escalation_conditions: If severance agreement contains a release of claims, recommend employment attorney review before signing (21/45-day consideration period for ADEA waiver).
If company is in bankruptcy, recommend priority claim inquiry for any deferred compensation.

stochastic_framing_rules: SAI is an estimate; actual need determination depends on IRS data match, verification process, and institutional methodology.
Schools with no-loan policies or institutional grants may produce a more favorable aid package than the SAI suggests.
escalation_conditions: If SAI implies significant unmet need and the student is considering expensive private schools, recommend filing the CSS Profile for additional institutional aid.
If the family has significant business assets or non-retirement investments, recommend a financial aid consultant review before the filing window.

stochastic_framing_rules: Program ROI comparisons use BLS OEWS median wages for the target occupation; actual post-graduation salary depends on specialty, geography, and employer.
IRR calculations are sensitive to discount rate and time horizon; report results at the stated parameters and note sensitivity.
escalation_conditions: If any program has a negative NPV at a 5% discount rate over the stated horizon, flag explicitly.
If total student debt would exceed 1.5× expected starting salary, recommend loan counseling before enrollment.

stochastic_framing_rules: H-1B lottery odds are estimates based on historical cap and petition volumes; actual selection is random within cap-exempt and cap-subject pools.
Priority date advancement for employment-based green cards (especially EB-3 India/China) is speculative; retrogression is common.
escalation_conditions: Any immigration strategy should be reviewed by a licensed immigration attorney before filing or making career decisions based on visa assumptions.
If employer sponsorship is involved, recommend verifying right-to-work documentation requirements and AC21 portability before changing employers.

stochastic_framing_rules: 457(b) governmental vs. non-governmental plans have materially different creditor protection and distribution rules — always specify plan type.
Deferral savings estimates assume the full marginal rate benefit; actual tax savings depend on filing status and total income.
escalation_conditions: Non-governmental 457(b) plans hold assets as employer general assets — flag employer financial health risk.
If participant is within 3 years of normal retirement age, note the special 'catch-up' provision allowing double deferrals under IRC §457(b)(3).

stochastic_framing_rules: Post-9/11 GI Bill tuition benefit is capped at $29,920.95 per academic year (AY2025-26) for private schools; public in-state tuition is fully covered.
BAH rate is based on E-5 with dependents for the school's ZIP code — verify actual rate at va.gov/education/benefit-rates.
escalation_conditions: If remaining entitlement is less than 36 months and the target program is longer, recommend a Yellow Ribbon or transfer of benefit review.
If veteran is also eligible for Vocational Rehabilitation (VR&E/Chapter 31), compare benefit packages before electing Chapter 33.

stochastic_framing_rules: DC-FSA vs. CDCTC comparison depends on marginal tax rate; at higher incomes, the FSA provides more value due to the payroll tax exclusion.
State tax treatment of DC-FSA and CDCTC varies; some states conform to federal treatment, others do not allow the credit or the FSA exclusion.
escalation_conditions: If household income exceeds $150,000, the CDCTC phases to 20% — DC-FSA is almost always preferred.
Two-earner households: both spouses need earned income; lower-earning spouse limits the benefit.

stochastic_framing_rules: Travel nurse stipends (housing, meals, incidentals) are non-taxable only if the nurse maintains a tax home; if the nurse lacks a bona fide tax home, the stipend is taxable income.
Total comp comparisons between staff and travel roles should include benefits differential (employer retirement match, health insurance) which travel often excludes.
escalation_conditions: If the travel nurse has not maintained a tax home for more than 12 months in any metropolitan area, recommend IRS Publication 463 review and potential CPA consultation on tax home status.
If total travel assignments in one location will exceed 12 months, IRS may reclassify that location as the tax home — reducing non-taxable stipend eligibility.

stochastic_framing_rules: Wage progression milestones are based on BLS OEWS and DOL RAPIDS apprenticeship data; union vs. non-union contracts differ significantly.
Journeyworker wage rates are highly local; BLS national medians are reference points, not guarantees.
escalation_conditions: If the user is comparing union vs. non-union paths, note the total compensation difference (pension, health, overtime rates) beyond base wage.
If the user is considering a multi-state career, verify license reciprocity before committing to a state-specific apprenticeship.

stochastic_framing_rules: Transition timelines are based on BLS unemployment duration data and self-reported median job search durations; individual results depend on network strength, geography, and market conditions.
Salary at destination occupation is BLS OEWS median; entry-level offers typically start below median, especially for career changers.
escalation_conditions: If the pivot requires a credential or degree costing more than 1 year of current salary, recommend an ROI analysis before committing.
If the user's savings runway is less than 6 months, recommend securing bridge employment or a part-time income source before making the pivot.

stochastic_framing_rules: HDHP/PPO break-even depends on actual healthcare utilization, which is uncertain; present as scenarios (low/medium/high utilizer), not predictions.
HSA investment projections assume the full contribution is invested; most employees leave HSA funds in cash — note the opportunity cost.
escalation_conditions: If the employee has a chronic condition or upcoming planned procedure, flag that HDHP out-of-pocket exposure may exceed the premium savings.
If the employee is pregnant or planning pregnancy, flag that HDHP deductibles apply per-person; a birth event will hit the family deductible limit.

stochastic_framing_rules: State tax liability estimates assume domicile in the work state and no reciprocity agreement; actual liability depends on number of days in each state (sourcing rules vary).
Convenience-of-employer rules (NY, CT, PA, NJ, DE, NE) can create dual taxation even when the employee works remotely from another state — flag if applicable.
escalation_conditions: If the employee works remotely in a state where the employer has no nexus, flag potential employer payroll tax registration requirements.
If NY Convenience of Employer rule applies, the employee may owe NY income tax on 100% of income even while working in a no-income-tax state — recommend CPA review.

stochastic_framing_rules: Cost-of-living indices are metro averages; actual cost depends on neighborhood, lifestyle, and family composition.
Remote salary adjustment policies vary by employer; some apply a geographic pay band, others use the employee's home metro, others maintain HQ rates.
escalation_conditions: If the employer applies a geographic pay band, recommend confirming the band before accepting a remote offer that includes a location change.
If the move is from a high-tax to a low-tax state, recommend verifying domicile change requirements (voter registration, driver's license, home purchase) to establish the new tax home.

stochastic_framing_rules: Net price estimates use published NCES data and school net price calculators; actual aid packages depend on enrollment year and school-specific policy.
College ROI projections assume graduation in 4 years; actual time-to-degree averages 5.1 years nationally — factor time extension risk into cost projections.
escalation_conditions: If projected parent contribution plus student borrowing exceeds 30% of current household income, flag affordability risk and recommend a net price calculator comparison.
If the student is considering a selective private school over a flagship public, confirm the aid package before committing — merit aid can flip the ROI.

stochastic_framing_rules: Enforceability scores are modeled on published state law trends and court outcomes — they are not legal opinions.
The FTC noncompete rule (2024) was subject to ongoing litigation as of 2026; enforceability at the federal level is uncertain — rely on state law analysis.
escalation_conditions: Any career move that could trigger a noncompete claim should be reviewed by an employment attorney before resignation.
If the noncompete covers a salary above $75,000 in a traditionally enforcement-friendly state (FL, TX, VA), recommend formal legal review.

stochastic_framing_rules: Scholarship probability estimates are based on reported GMAT/GRE percentile placement and program median statistics — they are indicative, not guaranteed.
Full-tuition vs. partial scholarship comparisons should account for the impact on career services access and alumni network quality, which are not captured in the financial model.
escalation_conditions: If the scholarship decision significantly changes the NPV across programs, recommend running the Graduate School ROI Comparator with and without the scholarship to compare break-even timelines.
If the scholarship has a GPA maintenance requirement, flag the risk of loss due to academic performance.

stochastic_framing_rules: Automation exposure scores reflect occupation-level task composition analysis — individual jobs vary significantly within an occupation based on employer and role scope.
WEF and BLS skill demand data reflects 2025 survey-period conditions; technology disruption timelines are inherently uncertain.
escalation_conditions: If automation exposure score exceeds 70%, recommend an immediate skills inventory and gap analysis against high-demand adjacent roles.
Do not present high automation exposure as a certain prediction of displacement — frame as a 10-year risk factor requiring proactive planning.

stochastic_framing_rules: Job search EV estimates assume the stated response and offer rates; actual rates vary by channel, role, and market conditions.
Accept vs. continue analysis depends on the value placed on optionality — surface the assumptions explicitly.
escalation_conditions: If accept verdict is marginal (within 5% of opportunity cost), recommend a 30-day reassessment before accepting.
If the search duration exceeds 6 months, recommend reassessing the target salary anchor and role scope.
